1.q: Can you work with my interior designer?
1.a: Yes. Send the drawings or renders on WhatsApp. Our team will review the project with you and your designer.

2.q: Can you furnish an entire space?
2.a: We make kitchens, wardrobes, storage and other interior furniture. Share the full project so the team can discuss the pieces together.

3.q: What should I send to get started?
3.a: A plan, a few inspiration photographs or a short description is a useful starting point. If you have drawings, send those too. The team will guide the next steps.

editorial.faqDesignerQuestion: Can you work from my designer’s drawings?
editorial.faqDesignerAnswer: Bring your designer’s drawings or use our design service. We review dimensions, materials and technical details together, then agree the specification, quote and delivery schedule.
editorial.faqNoDesignerQuestion: Can I start with an idea, and what does design cost?
editorial.faqNoDesignerAnswer: Start with a Pinterest photo, a rough idea or existing drawings. We consult, measure and develop the design and technical specification with you. Furniture 3D design and technical drawings: 30 GEL/m², calculated by front elevation. Full interior design: US$15–20/m², calculated by floor area.
editorial.faqTimelineQuestion: How long does a project take, and when is the price fixed?
editorial.faqTimelineAnswer: Plan approximately 6–8 weeks, around two months, overall. This is an estimate; reviews, workload, season and additional finishing can extend it. Design fees are separate from manufacturing. The furniture quotation follows consultation, 3D design and technical specification. The price is fixed for the agreed specification; customer-requested design or material revisions during review are re-estimated and approved before production.
editorial.faqVisitQuestion: Do you deliver and install outside Tbilisi?
editorial.faqVisitAnswer: Based in Tbilisi, with delivery and installation throughout Georgia. Logistics and installation are included in the agreed project quote.
